reason: A deals head-on with the late shelving report I had to chase: it gives the cause, names Dave Lin as responsible for the final report, sets a 30-day deadline and promises quarterly figures. It also discloses the $4,500 a year in van costs and doesn't promise more food than the farms have committed to. B never mentions the late report, leaves out the operating costs, and projects the full 9,000 pounds as if the farms had guaranteed it, which makes me trust it less.
